watch.summary: The creator sneaks up behind an enemy to attempt a knife kill, whiffs the strike completely, gets eliminated, and hysterically yells at chat to report him for throwing.

beats.what: Creator sneaks up behind an oblivious enemy while teammate talks on comms
Pulls out his knife right behind the enemy's head
Swings his knife and whiffs completely
Gets shot and eliminated instantly by a second enemy
Holds his head in utter shame and starts screaming at chat to report himself

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The universal comedy of greedily attempting a flashy knife kill only to whiff embarrassingly, paired with the creator's hilarious self-deprecating overreaction asking his chat to report him.
